revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - Proposed corrections are certainly correct.

Vote - AcceptText - The correction in line 2 is clearly correct. The proposal made for line 5 is paleographically defensible and likely right. What is not stated in the submission note (which probably should have been) is that Ἀλλώις is not attested elsewhere, which lends support to the proposed emendation. Ἀλλώις is, in other words, probably a ghostname. As for the end of line 19, the reading of the printed edition cannot stand. Hagedorn's correction is very compelling, although it is somewhat difficult to verify on the online image because of poor resolution.
On finalization: add num tags in line 10, 13f., 17, 19, 22, 26

Korrekturen anhand der Abbildung im Internet: Z. 2 Ὀξυρυνχιτῶν → Ὀξυρυγχειτῶν; Z. 5: Ἀλλώιτ̣ο̣ς̣ → Τ̣ααμόιτος̣ (τ̣ korrigiert aus α); Z. 19: το[ῦ δεκ]ά̣τ̣ο̣υ̣ ἔ̣τ̣ι̣ς̣ (l. ἔτους) → τὸ ἥ̣[μι]σ̣υ ὅ ἐστιν̣. Verweis auf BL VI 152 in Z. 17. Ferner Anpassung an den Apparat der ed. pr. in den Z. 1, 5, 8, 10, 11-12, 12, 20, 24 und 33.
